answers: A poster for my daughter Mira's 10th birthday party, hung at the entrance for family and her friends.
Wonder first, like looking up at a night sky, then warmth when they notice it is about her.
When she was seven she named a star after our cat, Pepper, and still checks on it from the balcony.
Must include: Mira, 10, Saturday 14 November. Please no pink and nothing cartoonish or cutesy.
